summary: Backoff loop & client retries after 429 lead to apparent timeouts/latency regressions on embeddings endpoint
description:
Issue summary: ParcelAI reports a sudden increase in perceived timeouts and slow responses for embeddings requests (POST /v1/embeddings) starting 2026-03-10 09:30 UTC.
Impact: Multiple customers within ParcelAI observe 5-15s spikes to >60s apparent failures; production job queues stalled; billing showed short bursts of high request rates. Customer-facing UI shows 'Request timed out' leading to retries.
Environment: prod - us-east, customer uses Dedicated pool tied to their tenant (tenant-id: parcel-008).
Steps to reproduce:
1) Send 50 concurrent embedding requests for a 1k token document to /v1/embeddings using customer API key.
2) Observe some requests returned 429 with Retry-After:2s, others succeeded with normal latency.
3) Customer client treats 429 as timeout and immediately retries up to 3 times with no backoff, amplifying load.
Observed behavior: High rate of 429s followed by a spike in successful requests that are slow (30-60s) or time out on client side. Service metrics show API gateway rate-limiter hitting quota windows; downstream serving-runtime shows elevated queue lengths and queued tokens.
Expected behavior: 429s should be rarer; clients should honor Retry-After and back off, preventing retry storms and preserving latency SLOs.
Logs (excerpts):
[2026-03-10T09:31:02Z] api-gateway: req_id=abc123 status=429 retry_after=2s tenant=parcel-008 rate_limit=per_minute=600 current_minute=602
[2026-03-10T09:31:03Z] client: parcel-sdk v2.1: retrying request id=abc123 attempt=1 (immediate)
[2026-03-10T09:31:04Z] serving-runtime: pool=dedicated-10 queue_depth=44 avg_latency=650ms token_throughput=12000/s
[2026-03-10T09:31:05Z] serving-runtime: queue_depth=128 avg_latency=4200ms token_throughput=4000/s
Attachments: latency graphs from Console (link in comments), request trace IDs.
comments: 2026-03-10 10:05 UTC - Support (Melanie Ortiz): Acknowledged. Escalating to SRE due to customer-visible latency and potential capacity amplification.
2026-03-10 10:23 UTC - SRE (Rohit Patel): Observed per-tenant rate-limiter counters exceeding configured burst windows. There's a mismatch between quota enforcement and gateway Retry-After policy.
2026-03-10 11:00 UTC - Customer (ParcelAI, Aaron Liu): Our SDK treats non-200 as transient and immediately retries. We will patch client to honor Retry-After and add jitter.
2026-03-11 09:12 UTC - Engineering (Anika Bose): Deployed temporary rate-limiter smoothing (windowed token bucket) to reduce immediate drop to 429s; monitoring for regression over 24h.
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: latency regression caused by model serving change; disproven - serving runtime CPU/GPU utilization normal before retry burst.
Root cause vector: aggressive client retries on 429s produce a retry storm that pushes per-tenant RPM above hard quota causing more 429s and increased serving queueing.
Observed gateway behavior: Retry-After header present but SDK ignores it. Some older SDK versions (v2.1) default to immediate retry on any 5xx/4xx non-auth errors.
Rate-limiter config: hard_quota=36000/hr soft_burst=600/min; customer's traffic pattern hit soft_burst often, causing gateway to return 429s with Retry-After=2s.
Traffic pattern: periodic batch jobs from ParcelAI sending bursts every 30s coinciding with their UI background syncs, aligning poorly with our minute-window quotas.
resolution_notes: Temporary mitigation: applied smoothing to rate-limiter windows and increased soft_burst to 900/min for parcel-008 for 48h to drain queues (rolled back after monitoring).
Customer mitigation: ParcelAI will ship SDK update to respect Retry-After and add exponential backoff with jitter in deadline patch 2.1.1.
Long-term: product to evaluate per-tenant adaptive rate windows and expose client-side recommended backoff in docs/console by 2026-04-01.
workaround: Applied tenant-specific soft_burst increase and advised customer to update SDK to honor Retry-After. For immediate relief, customer can stagger batch jobs and reduce concurrency.
next_steps: 1) Track latency and queue_depth metrics for parcel-008 over next 72h (Owner: Rohit).
2) Product ticket to add 'client-backoff' recommendations in Console quickstart (target 2026-04-01) (Owner: Priya Singh).
3) Engineering to evaluate adaptive per-tenant token-bucket algorithm and canary for new limiter (linked PR above) (Owner: Anika).
4) Follow up with ParcelAI once SDK patched to confirm no recurrence (Owner: Melanie).
